convert_torchvision_to_d2: run the script to convert a torchvision ResNet .pth model to a Detectron2 .pkl format
rename_layer_keys: run the script to rename torchvision layer keys like layer1 to res2 for Detectron2 compatibility
rename_bn_keys: run the script to rename torchvision batch norm keys like bn1 to conv1.norm for Detectron2
rename_downsample_keys: run the script to rename torchvision downsample keys to shortcut and shortcut.norm for Detectron2
dump_pickle_model: run the script to dump the converted model weights as a Detectron2 compatible pickle file
